instruction: Use up to 2000 actual GitHub Actions runs from EVA and construct chronological episodes only after real failed YADO workflows. Features must be available at the failed run or earlier. LOGIC predicts whether the next same-workflow run recovers. THINKING predicts the appropriate recovery ordering from the same episode. INTELLIGENCE predicts operational risk from current state. COGNITIVE may see only the three organ outputs and state-known and must choose ACT_REPAIR, VERIFY, REPLAN_VERIFY, or WITHHOLD. Use train-derived thresholds only, chronological train/validation/holdout, macro/balanced metrics, individual and combined organ ablations, single-organ baselines, source hashing and unchanged canonical G2. Do not lower thresholds after seeing holdout.
